draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Vellore! The big draw here is the 16th century Vellore Fort, built under the Vijayanagara Empire and known for its grand ramparts, wide moat and robust masonry.
draft.hungryLine: Vellore is famous for its biryani made with jeera sambha rice, so make that your first meal here.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at Vellore Fort and the Jalagandeswarar Temple with its carved gopuram, then head to Sripuram for the Golden Temple.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Drive about 25 km out to Amirthi Forest near Javathu mountain for the Amirthi Falls and a slow walk among the trees.
moodReplies.surprise-me: At the Golden Temple in Sripuram, you reach the shrine by walking a star-shaped path over 1.8 km long, past spiritual messages along the way.

spots.name: Vellore Fort
spots.detail: In the city · Grand 16th century fort with a wide moat and robust masonry

status.text: Go early to beat the heat

spots.name: Jalagandeswarar Temple
spots.detail: In the city · Vijayanagara-era Shiva temple with richly carved pillars and gopuram

spots.name: Golden Temple, Sripuram
spots.detail: Sripuram · Maha Lakshmi temple covered in gold, reached by a star-shaped path

tips.title: Know your limits at Sajra and Gojra.
tips.body: These clifftop forts are reachable only on foot, so plan when and how you climb.

tips.title: Dress for the temples.
tips.body: Between Jalagandeswarar, the Golden Temple and the Murugan hill temples, you'll want covered shoulders and knees.

story.title: Chola beginnings
story.body: Vellore's early history goes back to the Chola period in the 9th century CE. It then passed through various empires in the Middle Ages.

story.title: Fort and temple
story.body: The Vellore Fort and the Jalakandeswarar Temple went up under the Vijayanagara Empire. The temple is a fine example of Vijayanagara architecture.

story.title: Caught in the Carnatic Wars
story.body: In the 18th century, Vellore was drawn into the Carnatic Wars between the British and the French.

story.title: The Golden Temple
story.body: The gold-covered temple at Sripuram was dedicated to Sri Lakshmi Narayani in 2007. Every detail was made by hand by artisans who specialise in gold temple art.

story.title: City of healing
story.body: Christian Medical College draws students, doctors and patients from all over India. The city sits on the Palar River, ringed by the Javadi Hills.

food.name: The Vellore Kitchen
food.detail: South Indian chicken and mutton dishes, plus seafood

food.name: Zaitoon Katpadi
food.detail: Middle Eastern style restaurant at Selvam Square, Katpadi
